title.value: Advanced Diffusion MR Imaging for Multiple Sclerosis in the Brain and Spinal Cord
title.justification: The paper focuses on advanced diffusion MRI techniques for assessing multiple sclerosis (MS) in the brain and spinal cord.
title.quote: Advanced Diffusion MR Imaging for Multiple Sclerosis in the Brain and Spinal Cord

extractions.description: The paper reviews recent advances in diffusion MRI techniques for evaluating multiple sclerosis in the brain and spinal cord, focusing on new imaging methods such as q-space imaging, diffusional kurtosis imaging, and neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging. These methods aim to capture microstructural changes in normal and pathological states of the brain and spinal cord with greater detail than conventional methods.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on medical imaging advancements for multiple sclerosis, which does not directly relate to environmental or climate sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This paper reviews the current status of recent advanced diffusion MRI for assessing MS in vivo as part of an issue celebrating two decades of magnetic resonance in medical sciences (MRMS), an official journal of the Japanese Society of Magnetic Resonance in Medicine.
